programs.title: Chopped: Food Truck Kitchen
programs.desc: Food truck chefs battle it out  Chinese and Greek cuisine ingredients in the first basket  a classic American street food meets a fun-to-say Korean dish in the entrée basket  unripe fruit and a much-loved sweet spread in the final basket.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.desc: Actress Ali Larter links up with chef Michael Voltaggio to blind Bobby Flay with the bright lights of Hollywood and defeat him  international chefs Jorge Gonzalez and Yuri Szarzewski attempt to throw Bobby off his game with their global fare.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.desc: "Chopped" judge Alex Guarnaschelli teams up with "Chopped Sweets" judge Elizabeth Chambers to give Bobby Flay some bittersweet memories  they recruit chefs Leanne Mascoli and Melanie Moss, who are sweet on walking away with a win.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: Sweets to have with morning coffee.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: An exploration into all that Chicago has to offer, in places such as Salted Caramel, Lovely Bakeshop and Southport Grocery and Café.

programs.title: Food Paradise: Noodle Nirvana
programs.desc: From New York City Sicilians serving spaghetti in a cone, to a Vietnamese chef in Venice Beach rolling ramen noodles in a burrito, these chefs think way outside the pasta box.
